name: Payroll Report
query:
SELECT
    w.`employee`,
    MAX(w.`employee_name`) as `employee_name`,
    ROUND(SUM(w.`regular_hours`), 2) as 'regular_hours',
    ROUND(SUM(w.`overtime_hours`), 2) as 'overtime_hours',
    ROUND(SUM(w.`total_hours`), 2) as 'total_hours',
    LEAST(SUM(w.`missed_punch`), 1)
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            z.`week`,
            z.`employee`,
            MAX(z.`employee_name`) as `employee_name`,
            LEAST(SUM(z.`seconds`) / 3600, 40) as `regular_hours`,
            GREATEST((SUM(z.`seconds`) / 3600) - 40, 0) as `overtime_hours`,
            SUM(z.`seconds`) / 3600 as `total_hours`,
            CASE
                WHEN MIN(z.`seconds`) <= 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END as `missed_punch`
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    tmp.`week` as `week`,
                    tmp.`employee`,
                    MAX(tmp.`employee_name`) as `employee_name`,
                    MAX(tmp.`punch_unix`) - MIN(tmp.`punch_unix`) as `seconds`
                FROM
                    (
                        SELECT
                            pd.`employee`,
                            pd.`employee_name`,
                            CONCAT(YEAR(pd.`time`), '/', WEEK(pd.`time`)) as `week`,
                            CEILING(
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                    PARTITION BY pd.`employee`,
                                    CONCAT(YEAR(pd.`time`), '/', WEEK(pd.`time`))
                                    ORDER BY
                                        pd.`time`
                                ) / 2
                            ) as `seq`,
                            pd.`docstatus`,
                            UNIX_TIMESTAMP(pd.`time`) as `punch_unix`
                        FROM
                            `tabEmployee Checkin` pd
                        WHERE
                            pd.`docstatus` = 0
                            AND pd.`time` >= %(start_date)s
                            AND pd.`time` < DATE_ADD(%(end_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    ) tmp
                GROUP BY
                    tmp.`week`,
                    tmp.`employee`,
                    tmp.`seq`
            ) z
        GROUP BY
            z.`week`,
            z.`employee`
        ORDER BY
            z.`week`,
            z.`employee`
    ) w
GROUP BY
    w.`employee`
ORDER BY
    `employee_name`,
    w.`employee`
